About this gameFull description from Steam+
Rocksmith 2014 Remastered is back by popular demand! Whether you're a beginner or an experienced player, it's a fantastic way to learn guitar or bass at your own pace, now available in an all-new 2024 edition. Get ready to rock (again)! In 2023, Rocksmith 2014 Remastered was temporarily removed due to the expiration of our music licensing deals. While we believe Rocksmith+ offers the ultimate destination for learning guitar, bass and piano with its extensive music catalog, we have also heard the Rocksmith 2014 community’s feedback. You asked for Rocksmith 2014 Remastered to return, so we did just that! We have been hard at work to deliver a special version giving you the choice to own your songs and enjoy popular features like Guitarcade and Session Mode. Introducing Rocksmith 2014 Remastered Learn & Play Edition! WHAT'S NEW IN THIS EDITION? While Rocksmith 2014 Remastered Learn & Play retains all the core features you love, we’ve replaced all licensed songs with a collection of tracks and exercises from our popular downloadable content bundles. This includes: • Bachsmith and Bachsmith II • Classic Melody Song Pack • Rocksmith Easy Exercises, Vol. 1 & 2 • Rocksmith Intermediate Exercises, Vol. 1 & 2 • Rocksmith Advanced Exercises, Vol. 1 & 2 These bundles cover a wide range of techniques and musical styles to help you develop your skills and learn new ones. Rocksmith 2014 Remastered Learn & Play Edition is identical to the original in all other aspects. You can still easily learn songs thanks to the 3D Noteway, enjoy Multiplayer with friends, or refine your skills with Riff Repeater. Best of all, the downloadable songs from the original Rocksmith 2014 Remastered are fully compatible with Learn & Play Edition, allowing you to easily create your own personalized song library. Our home-made official content is carefully craftedto sound and play like a fined tuned guitar, so if you want to find the best song versions, you know where to come! LEARN & PLAY YOUR FAVORITE SONGS Rocksmith 2014 Remastered Learn & Play Edition is a great and fun way to learn and play real music, focusing on the songs you love. Whether you're picking up your first guitar or aiming to perfect advanced techniques, the game adapts to your skill level and offers comprehensive practice tools and options, ensuring you progress quickly, no matter where you start. Join millions of players who have already mastered guitar using Rocksmith's award-winning method. Using a Real Tone Cable, simply plug any real guitar or bass into your PC to start your musical journey today!! IMPORTANT NOTES • If you already own Rocksmith 2014 Remastered on Steam, please be aware that you won’t be able to download the Learn & Play edition to avoid losing your original base game’s licensed music. • We are aware of an issue preventing new users from creating a Uplay account with the current password requirements. The correct password guidelines are: o 8 to 16 characters o At least 1 lowercase letter o At least 1 uppercase letter o At least 1 number o At least 1 special character o Passwords must not contain your username Please note that additional downloadable songs cannot be purchased directly via the in-game store interface and need to be purchased directly via the Steam store instead. Once purchased, those additional downloadable songs will be added to the game's song list automatically.
